row:
The Big Cat Sanctuary in Kent is a centre dedicated to the conservation of wild cats, with the objectives of rescue, welfare, breeding, education and conservation. The initiatives undertaken are a vital part in saving some of the planet’s most endangered and iconic species from extinction. 

The Sanctuary is proud to have contributed to the accredited global breeding programmes as well as donating to in-situ conservation projects. The centre offers personal big cat experiences including overnight stays, photography workshops, ranger days and educational tours.

Please note we are not open to the public, but you can visit our cats by booking one of our Open Days or exclusive experiences at www.thebigcatsanctuary.org
